summary: Join our Governance & Food Safety in International Food Chains Course. Gain insights into effective strategies for managing food safety across borders.
lede: Food safety governance training helps intermediate and advanced food safety practitioners coordinate preventive controls across supply chains. It supports the practical work of linking accountability with hazard assessment, risk-based supplier approval, traceability testing, and verified corrective action, using records such as specifications, audit reports, laboratory results, and withdrawal logs to inform operational and executive decisions.
audienceIntro: Food safety governance training suits professionals who coordinate preventive controls, supplier assurance, audits, traceability, and incident decisions across international food chains. It supports intermediate and advanced practitioners who already work with food safety records and need a more integrated governance model.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to food safety procedures, HACCP records, supplier documentation, quality audits, or food chain operations. Prior knowledge of ISO 22000:2018 is useful but not essential. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted anomaly detection, Power BI reporting, GFSI benchmarking, VACCP, and TACCP receive operational application or conceptual treatment rather than production-system implementation.
